notablePrerequisites: You control a white nontoken Vampire with toughness two or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving the nontoken white Vampire persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Vampire, adding {C}{C}.
The Vampire dies, triggering its persist ability and Cordial Vampire.
Resolve the Vampire's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Cordial Vampire trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
Repeat.
